mapper.select: SELECT * FROM research_preparation_job ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(id) FROM research_preparation_job WHERE status='SUCCESS'
SELECT source_codes_json FROM research_preparation_job WHERE status='SUCCESS' AND id>=COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM research_preparation_job WHERE status='SUCCESS' AND all_sources=1),0)
SELECT * FROM research_prepared_document WHERE source_code=#{source} AND valid_until IS NULL AND (source_hash IN #{h} OR source_row_id IN #{id})
mapper.update: UPDATE research_prepared_document SET valid_until=#{revision} WHERE id=#{id} AND valid_until IS NULL
UPDATE research_prepared_document SET valid_until=#{revision} WHERE source_code=#{source} AND valid_until IS NULL AND seen_run<>#{revision}
UPDATE research_prepared_document SET valid_until=#{revision} WHERE valid_until IS NULL AND source_code NOT IN #{s}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO research_prepared_identity(revision,doi,pmid) SELECT #{revision},doi,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT pmid)=1 THEN MIN(pmid) ELSE NULL END FROM research_prepared_document WHERE valid_from<=#{revision} AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until>#{revision}) AND doi IS NOT NULL AND record_kind='PUBLICATION' GROUP BY doi
mapper.delete: DELETE m FROM ${table} m JOIN research_prepared_document d ON d.id=m.document_id WHERE d.valid_from=#{revision}
mapper.update: UPDATE research_prepared_document SET valid_until=NULL WHERE valid_until=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${table} m LEFT JOIN research_prepared_document d ON d.id=m.document_id WHERE d.id IS NULL OR m.source_code<>d.source_code OR m.document_key<>d.document_key OR NOT(m.pmid<=>d.pmid) OR NOT(m.doi<=>d.doi)
SELECT * FROM research_preparation_source_cursor WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND source_code=#{source}
SELECT * FROM research_preparation_source_cursor WHERE job_id=#{jobId} ORDER BY source_code

SELECT c.* FROM research_preparation_source_cursor c JOIN research_preparation_job j ON j.id=c.job_id WHERE c.source_code=#{source} AND c.status='COMPLETE' AND j.status='SUCCESS' ORDER BY c.job_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE research_preparation_source_cursor SET status=#{status},after_update_time=#{afterUpdateTime},after_id=#{afterId} WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND source_code=#{sourceCode}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_prepared_document d JOIN ${table} m ON m.document_id=d.id WHERE d.valid_from=#{revision} AND (m.source_code<>d.source_code OR m.document_key<>d.document_key OR NOT(m.pmid<=>d.pmid) OR NOT(m.doi<=>d.doi))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_prepared_document WHERE source_code=#{source} AND source_row_id IS NULL AND valid_until IS NULL
